# Queensland Public Service Salary Scales
## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the AO 2 salary?
An Administrative AO 2 (also written as AO2 or Administrative Officer Level 2) earns $63,814 to $75,997 per year as set by the Queensland Public Service Officers and Other Employees Award – State 2015 (reprinted 1 September 2026).
